<documents>
<document id="direct-deposit-early">
EarlyˆdirectˆdepositˆWithˆearlyˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆyouˆcanˆgetˆyourˆpaycheckˆupˆtoˆ2ˆdaysˆbeforeˆyourˆemployer'sˆofficialˆpayday.ˆIt'sˆincludedˆonˆeveryˆplanˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆ##ˆHowˆitˆworksˆEmployersˆsendˆpayrollˆfilesˆtoˆbanksˆaˆfewˆdaysˆbeforeˆpayday.ˆWhenˆweˆreceiveˆyours,ˆweˆmakeˆtheˆmoneyˆavailableˆrightˆawayˆinsteadˆofˆwaitingˆforˆtheˆofficialˆpayˆdate.ˆ##ˆWhyˆtimingˆvariesˆHowˆearlyˆyou'reˆpaidˆdependsˆonˆwhenˆyourˆemployerˆsendsˆtheˆfile.ˆSomeˆpayˆperiodsˆyouˆmightˆgetˆpaidˆtwoˆdaysˆearly,ˆothersˆoneˆday,ˆorˆonˆpaydayˆitself.ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆanˆemployerˆsendˆitˆsooner.ˆ##ˆThingsˆtoˆknowˆ-ˆEarlyˆdirectˆdepositˆisˆautomatic.ˆThere'sˆnothingˆtoˆswitchˆon.ˆ-ˆItˆappliesˆtoˆpayrollˆandˆgovernmentˆbenefitsˆsentˆbyˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆtransfersˆyouˆmakeˆyourselfˆorˆtoˆBrookPay.ˆ-ˆIfˆanˆemployerˆcancelsˆorˆreversesˆaˆpayrollˆfile,ˆtheˆdepositˆmayˆbeˆreversed.ˆIfˆyourˆpaycheckˆisˆlateˆonˆyourˆofficialˆpayday,ˆcheckˆwithˆyourˆemployerˆfirst.ˆTheyˆcanˆconfirmˆwhenˆandˆwhereˆitˆwasˆsent.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="direct-deposit-setup">
SettingˆupˆdirectˆdepositˆDirectˆdepositˆsendsˆyourˆpaycheck,ˆorˆbenefits,ˆstraightˆintoˆyourˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆ##ˆSetˆitˆupˆ-ˆ**Automatic:**ˆtapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDirectˆdeposit,ˆthenˆSetˆupˆautomatically.ˆFindˆyourˆemployerˆorˆpayrollˆproviderˆandˆsignˆin.ˆTheˆswitchˆhappensˆinˆtheˆpayrollˆsystem.ˆ-ˆ**Manual:**ˆdownloadˆaˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆfromˆtheˆsameˆscreen,ˆorˆcopyˆyourˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber,ˆandˆgiveˆitˆtoˆyourˆemployer.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆEmployersˆusuallyˆneedˆoneˆorˆtwoˆpayˆcyclesˆtoˆmakeˆtheˆswitch.ˆYourˆfirstˆpaycheckˆmayˆstillˆgoˆtoˆyourˆoldˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhelpsˆ-ˆYouˆmayˆgetˆpaidˆupˆtoˆ2ˆdaysˆearly.ˆ-ˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdaysˆtoˆuseˆCushion.ˆ##ˆSplittingˆaˆpaycheckˆYourˆemployerˆmayˆletˆyouˆsplitˆyourˆpayˆbetweenˆaccounts.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆsetˆupˆanˆautomaticˆtransferˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆtoˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆonˆpayday.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="transfers-holidays">
WeekendsˆandˆbankˆholidaysˆSomeˆkindsˆofˆpaymentˆonlyˆmoveˆonˆbusinessˆdays.ˆBusinessˆdaysˆareˆMondayˆtoˆFriday,ˆexceptˆbankˆholidays.ˆ##ˆWhatˆpausesˆonˆweekendsˆandˆholidaysˆ-ˆACHˆtransfersˆtoˆandˆfromˆlinkedˆaccountsˆ-ˆDomesticˆandˆinternationalˆwiresˆ-ˆMobileˆcheckˆdepositsˆ(theyˆcountˆasˆreceivedˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday)ˆ##ˆWhatˆworksˆeveryˆdayˆ-ˆCardˆpurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ-ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆbetweenˆmembersˆ-ˆTransfersˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆSavingsˆPocketsˆ-ˆCashˆdepositsˆatˆretailˆstoresˆ##ˆPaydaysˆnearˆaˆholidayˆIfˆyourˆpaydayˆfallsˆonˆaˆholiday,ˆyourˆemployerˆusuallyˆsendsˆpayrollˆearlier,ˆandˆearlyˆdirectˆdepositˆmayˆpayˆyouˆsoonerˆstill.ˆ##ˆTimelinesˆinˆbusinessˆdaysˆWhenˆweˆsayˆsomethingˆtakesˆaˆnumberˆofˆbusinessˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆcardˆdelivery,ˆdisputeˆcreditsˆorˆtransferˆarrival,ˆweekendsˆandˆbankˆholidaysˆaren'tˆcounted.ˆSupportˆisˆopenˆeveryˆday,ˆincludingˆholidays.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can I get my paycheck 5 days early with early direct deposit?
